issues.quote: The old clock in the hall has its own face and its own ways, and I do not touch it.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the hall clock's accuracy or behavior. R4 gives the hall-clock strike only as a comparison against the kitchen clock.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as a hint that the hall clock runs irregularly, and so doubt or discount the R4 strike at eleven, even though R4 is stated directly against the kitchen clock.

issues.quote: Everyone in this house knows I keep it fast.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says only that Rosa keeps her kitchen clock fast on purpose (R1). It says nothing about what others in the house know or whether they set their own clocks by it.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this to mean the other household members had already adjusted their own readings to the kitchen clock's offset, which would bear on how to convert any other clock's reading.
